verdicts.trueWording: Elementals are beings from the Elemental Planes
verdicts.unsupportedLimb: that the phrase survives only in spell text, the Amulet of the Planes and the Elementals creature-type note
verdicts.note: Quote verbatim, SRD 5.2.1 p. 254 creature-types list. First limb CONFIRMED: title-case 'Planes of Existence' occurs 0 times in the 364-page PDF, no such section or heading, and WotC's own SRD page records the appendix as removed. Second limb refuted by count: lower-case 'planes of existence' occurs 6 times, in the Arcana skill entry, the Rare Languages note, a divination spell's list of facts, Sending, the telepathic-bond spell and the GM's Areas of Knowledge table; singular 'plane of existence' occurs 43 more. The Amulet of the Planes reads 'another plane of existence' (singular), and the Elementals note says 'Elemental Planes', not 'planes of existence' - so two of the three named homes are wrong and the real homes are unlisted. Route: curl browser UA + pdftotext -enc UTF-8 (cross-checked -raw, -layout).

verdicts.trueWording: as those are not rules-bearing to play fifth edition
verdicts.note: Raw page reached at www.dndbeyond.com/srd (dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document 301s there, curl browser UA, 197 KB HTML). The Appendix row of the SRD 5.1-vs-5.2 differences table carries the sentence with both appendix names, verbatim. Page footer: last updated March 02, 2026, as cited.

verdicts.trueWording: not to replicate every element of the D&D brand or setting
verdicts.note: SRD 5.2 FAQ, answer to 'Why is [class, spell, monster, etc.] not in SRD 5.2?'; the sentence opens 'SRD 5.2 is designed to give creators a strong foundation for building original material,' then the quoted clause. Both limbs (foundation for original material; not reproducing the setting) supported.

verdicts.trueWording: as that is not featured in the 5.5e core rules
verdicts.note: The quoted fragment is verbatim in the Game Rules row of the SRD 5.2 differences table, but the page attributes the removal to the '5.5e core rules' and never says '2024'; the only '2024' on the page is the footer copyright line. 5.5e is the 2024 revision, so the substance holds - downstream copy should use the page's wording, not '2024 core rules'.

English Downloads list item, rendered contiguously (the link text plus the parenthetical in the same <li>). Previous SRD Releases section lists 'SRD v5.2.0 (Published: April 22, 2025)', supporting the second limb. Same list gives the two PDF URLs used for claims 1022 and 1027-1029.

verdicts.trueWording: Many more game terms are capitalized in SRD 5.2.1
verdicts.note: Conversion guide p. 1, 'Using This Guide', step 3 'Update Capitalization'; the sentence continues 'than in 5.1; update their capitalization in your content to match', so the 'than in SRD 5.1' limb holds. PDF fetched with browser UA (2.47 MB, 15 pp.), pdftotext -enc UTF-8.

verdicts.trueWording: Game objects are more rigorously capitalized.
verdicts.note: Opening sentence of the 'Capitalization' section, conversion guide p. 15, immediately before the bulleted list. Verbatim including the period.

CONFIRMED by independent count: 75 bullets exactly, from 'Abilities {Strength, Intelligence}' to 'Named parts of actions, class features, magic items, spells, etc.', spanning pp. 15-16 of the guide (grep -c '^•' over the section = 75). Quote verbatim (line-wrapped as 'The / following terms are capitalized:').

verdicts.unsupportedLimb: that the capitalized form appears 52 times in SRD 5.2.1
verdicts.note: Two limbs reproduce exactly: lower-case 'difficult terrain' 48 times in SRD 5.1 and 0 times in SRD 5.2.1 (identical under default and -raw extraction). The third does not: capitalized 'Difficult Terrain' counts 54 (default), 49 (-raw), 42 (-layout, which mis-joins the two columns); 52 reproduces under no route. Since the finder's 5.1 figures match default/raw exactly, 54 is the like-for-like number. All 54 hits are body text spread over 38 pages - the PDF has no index, and no hit sits in the Contents.

verdicts.unsupportedLimb: that the capitalized form appears 50 times in SRD 5.2.1
verdicts.note: Lower-case limbs reproduce exactly: 'bright light' 54 times in SRD 5.1, 0 times in SRD 5.2.1 (default and -raw). Capitalized 'Bright Light' counts 53 under the matching route (53 under -raw, 50 only under -layout, which mis-joins columns and also undercounts the 5.1 figures to 46, so it cannot be the finder's route); one further sentence-initial 'Bright light' exists in 5.2.1, giving 54 any-case. 53 hits across 34 pages, all body text.

verdicts.unsupportedLimb: that the capitalized form appears 72 times in SRD 5.2.1
verdicts.note: Lower-case limbs reproduce exactly: 'temporary hit points' 27 times in SRD 5.1, 0 times in SRD 5.2.1. Capitalized 'Temporary Hit Points' counts 76 (default), 74 (-raw), 58 (-layout); 72 reproduces under no route. One of the 76 is the Contents entry on p. 2, so the body figure is 75; 14 of the rest cluster on p. 18 (the Hit Points rules). Discrepancy is the same direction and size as claims 1030-1031.

verdicts.trueWording: Exploration involves delving into places that are dangerous and full of mystery.
verdicts.note: CONFIRMED on both sides. SRD 5.2.1 p. 11 (footer '11'), under the heading 'Exploration'; the sentence counts 12 words. SRD 5.1 p. 86 (footer '86'), under 'The Environment', reads 'By its nature, adventuring involves delving into places that are dark, dangerous, and full of mysteries to be explored' - 19 words, with 'dark' dropped and 'mysteries to be explored' reduced to 'mystery'. Both cited page numbers check out.

verdicts.trueWording: detail some of the ways adventurers interact with the environment
verdicts.note: CONFIRMED. SRD 5.2.1 p. 11 second sentence counts 18 words; the SRD 5.1 p. 86 counterpart, which carries 'cover some of the most important ways in which' verbatim, counts 22. Both replacement fragments quoted in the claim are exact.

verdicts.trueWording: transports you and up to 199 other willing creatures
verdicts.note: Quote verbatim in the SRD 5.2.1 Rod of Security entry, which continues 'you can see to a demiplane' and repeats 'demiplane' three more times. The SRD 5.1 counterpart (SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf, media.wizards.com, same browser-UA + pdftotext route) reads 'to a paradise that exists in an extraplanar space' verbatim. Note the claim's url field cites only the 5.2.1 PDF; the 5.1 half was verified against the 5.1 PDF.

verdicts.trueWording: Dungeon Master (DM): After passing through the craggy peaks
verdicts.note: CONFIRMED. Front matter reads 'D&D Basic Rules, Version 1.0, Released November 2018'. The DM speech from 'After passing through the craggy peaks' to 'spilling into the courtyard.' counts exactly 127 words (130 with the speaker label). Negative limb also holds: neither SRD 5.1 nor SRD 5.2.1 contains a single 'DM:' or 'GM:' dialogue turn, the phrase 'craggy peaks', or this passage (0 hits each). One citation slip: the passage is on printed page 3 (PDF page 3, footer '3'), not p. 2 as the claim's page field says - p. 2 is the Contents.
